I presume you are referring to a banner graphic.

The Voat default Stylesheet doesn't have any banner graphic customization, so the CSS needs to be customized to include a banner graphic.

There is no "standard measurement" because banner graphics are a customization.

You just make it as tall or as short as you like.

/v/TheUnexplained has a banner graphic of 1920 pix x 200 pix, which is a little taller than most of the other subs that I've seen that also have banner graphics.

That said, I didn't completely design /v/TheUnexplained... I just redesigned the banner graphic after the sub was abandoned by it's previous owner and the old banner image was lost when the crappy image service died. I personally prefer banners that scale depending on the width of the browser window, like with /v/Ghosts.

When designing banner graphics, I tend to make 'em 1920 pix wide and between 150 - 200 pix heigh, but I also make sure to optimize the JPEG compression to make the image look great, but also be small in file size. 85% compression usually looks fine for most images.
